name: Weighted Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding the plate against your chest.
Brace your abs firmly and keep your lower back settled toward the floor.
Exhale as you curl your head, shoulders, and upper back smoothly off the floor toward your pelvis.
Pause briefly to squeeze your abs at the top, then lower your shoulders slowly back down to the ground.
tips: Lift strictly by flexing your upper spine rather than yanking the weight plate upward with momentum.
Keep your gaze slightly up toward the ceiling so your neck stays comfortable.
